title: Rapid PVST+ (RSTP)
description: Understand Rapid Spanning Tree and how it converges faster than classic STP.
scenario: Understand Rapid Spanning Tree and how it converges faster than classic STP.

concepts.title: RSTP vs STP
concepts.body: RSTP (802.1w) converges in seconds instead of 30-50 seconds. It uses port roles: root, designated, alternate, backup.

concepts.title: RSTP Port Roles
concepts.body: Alternate ports provide a backup path to root. Backup ports back up designated ports. Both are discarding until needed.
concepts.code:
Root → forwards
Designated → forwards
Alternate → backup to root
Backup → backup to designated

concepts.title: Enabling RSTP
concepts.body: Cisco switches use Rapid PVST+ (per-VLAN RSTP). Enable it globally with "spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst".
